# Security contract

**Status:** Approved

Status codes: the API answers 401 to an unauthenticated call.

## Withdrawn requirements

- SEC-3: Passwords rotate every 30 days.

## SEC-4

The application must require multi-factor authentication
for every administrator sign-in.

## SEC-6 Reject deprecated TLS versions

The application must refuse TLS 1.0 and 1.1.
